scope: Read-only generic MEM-AP sampling of installed native-drawer-ease UI timing; no halt, reset, target write or native call.
limitations: Each context read and separate queue read is non-atomic; fields may span GUI updates.
shown means successful native PAN admission, not measured LCD scanout.
Sampling does not identify all GUI frames or correlate individual gestures to the user's visual classification.

assessment.supported: The old previous-GUI timestamp and steep initial cubic ease-out can produce a large first calculated displacement before the first admitted animation pose.
assessment.not_established: The observed samples do not establish that the entire 120 ms animation expired before its first pose, or that animation begins while the finger remains held.
assessment.proposed_change: Anchor from the last valid admitted pose, start with a fresh clock after origin admission, then use 150 ms smoothstep with at most 30 ms phase progress per successfully admitted frame. Direct follow-finger movement remains unchanged.
assessment.tradeoff: Animation wall time adapts to rendering and queue delays; this favors consistent intermediate poses over catching up to an absolute deadline.
